officialText:
Section 480.1 – Retitle the Informational Note in Section 480.1 “Informational Note No. 1” and add a new Informational Note to read as follows:

Informational Note No. 2: Refer to Article 706, Energy Storage Systems, for additional requirements when Storage Batteries are used in such a system.
